name: Yujun
contribution: Created Cursor Academy as a module of Academic Research Skills to empower scholars with AI-assisted research capabilities.
headline: AI-Powered Academic Research & Writing Suite
summary: Cursor Academy is part of the Academic Research Skills suite, designed to help scholars draft papers, perform deep literature reviews, and audit citations with absolute logical consistency and anti-hallucination guardrails.
body: Cursor Academy bridges the gap between raw AI potential and rigorous scientific publication. Built as a multi-agent framework, it manages the full research lifecycle—from Socratic brainstorming, PRISMA-guided systematic reviews, to LaTeX compilation and full-reference integrity auditing. It empowers researchers to focus on core arguments while letting AI handle formatting and compliance checks, transforming how academia interacts with generative tools.
